definitions.meaning: A reward, recompense given by the hand, retribution

quotations.old_english: Uton wé geþencean hwylc handleán wé him forþ tó berenne habban
quotations.english: let us consider what recompense we have to offer him

source_text: hand-leán, es; n. A reward, recompense given by the hand, retribution :-- Uton wé geþencean hwylc handleán wé him forþ tó berenne habban let us consider what recompense we have to offer him, Blickl. Homl. 91, 13: Cd. 143; Th. 178, 29; Exod. 19: Beo.Th. 3087; B. 1541: 4195; B. 2094. [O. H. Ger. hant-lón bravium.]
